terminal/style#

Colors and text attributes, rendered for the terminal's color depth.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let warning = TextStyle(foreground: NamedColor(BasicColor.yellow), background: DefaultColor(), attributes: [TextAttribute.bold]);
session.output().writeln(StyledText(origin: "careful", style: warning));
StyledText(origin: "x", style: warning).rendered(TerminalColorDepth.basic);   // escape codes and text

Description#

Colors and text attributes, rendered for the terminal's color depth.

A color is lowered to what the terminal shows: true color to 256 colors to 8, and nothing when colors are off.
